findings.why: The paid-partnership tag is there, but only in the hashtag block at the end of the caption, where it is likely hidden below the 'see more' cut. The disclosure needs to be upfront and clearly visible.
findings.fix: Put '#ad' (or the Paid partnership label) in the first line of the caption.

rule_hit_review.why: 'FREE' here is the comment keyword, and the same caption states the condition (a free glass water bottle when you buy any 2 products).

tone_read: This is a creator ad in the creator's own voice, so brand tone rules don't apply; it is low-key and conversational, with no fear hook or hype. The routine mention is understated ('quietly become part of my everyday routine').
language_read: No efficacy claims are made about the SPF 50 or the Salicylic Acid Cleanser, and the free-bottle offer carries its purchase condition. The only gap is where the '#ad' disclosure sits in the caption.
